title: Live updates: Bitcoin nears $65,000 as oil, inflation hopes keep macro bid alive
summary: Trump’s comments on jobs, inflation and a possible Strait of Hormuz deal have helped risk sentiment, but bitcoin’s next move depends on whether lower oil actually pulls Treasury yields and the dollar down.

title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
summary: A volunteer group running AI models against bitcoin codebases says it is averaging roughly one critical bug per hour per person, at about $10,000 a day in compute.

title: S&P 500 has added crypto's $2 trillion market cap this month. Bitcoin is not impressed. Here's why
summary: The S&P 500 just added roughly the entire crypto market's value this month. Bitcoin has barely moved, and the reasons go beyond the obvious.

title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as traders watch $100 billion SpaceX unlock
summary: Korea's Kospi fell 4.4% as the AI trade wobbled, and $101 billion of SpaceX stock becomes tradable Thursday.

title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
summary: CryptoQuant said large XRP spot orders point to "quiet accumulation" rather than a breakout, while ether’s price below realized value leaves holders underwater and gives it the strongest valuation case among BTC, ETH and XRP.
